users.services module

This module contains helper functions that handle user creation, role assignments, and account activation. These are used by the views to keep the logic clean and organized.

Raised when the specified role does not exist.

users.services.create_user_with_role(*, username, password, email='', first_name='', last_name='', role_name=None)[fuente]

Create a new user and assign them a single role.

Parámetros:

  • username (str) – The new username.

  • password (str) – The password in plain text (will be hashed with make_password).

  • email (str) – Optional email address.

  • first_name (str) – Optional first name.

  • last_name (str) – Optional last name.

  • role_name (str | None) – Optional role to assign right after creation.

Devuelve:

The created User object.

Raises:

UsernameTaken: If the username is already in use. RoleNotFound: If the role does not exist.

User
